create_world_with_bots: create a World instance that spawns N bots at random positions on a 5x5 grid
step_world_simulation: step the World simulation to move all bots one random position on the grid
get_bots_by_entity_id: get all bots or filter bots by entity ID from the World instance
remove_bot_from_world: remove a bot from the World by its entity ID
visualize_world_grid: visualize the World grid with bot positions and agent location using matplotlib
